input: Lack of capability or robustness is a risk associated with An automated system is designed to detect and respond to copyrighted content in real-time, identifying and flagging potential infringement. It aims to protect intellectual property by monitoring and analyzing audio streams for copyrighted material. The system seeks to prevent unauthorized use of copyrighted content by taking appropriate actions when detected.
